description: Australia's eSafety scheme recorded reports rising more than 960% from 849 in 2018/19 to 9,060 in 2022/23, led by sexual extortion reports going from 432 to 6,187.
energy_note: Four hundred and thirty-two, to six thousand.

aspect: The burden of removal falls on the target
description: Platforms rely on manual reporting, which is time-consuming and re-traumatising: the person must find and report the material separately on every platform, and cannot pre-emptively report something they cannot prove is there.
energy_note: Searching for it yourself, repeatedly, to have it taken down.

description: Downstream distribution - re-posting by third parties - means each removal addresses one copy, and deplatforming research indicates moderation displaces rather than eliminates.
A screenshot of her contacts list. Then: 'I haven't sent it to anyone. Yet.' Then, twenty minutes later: 'I don't want anything. I just want you to talk to me.'
energy_note: He does not want money. He wants her to reply.
